positive_terms: Description of how new baseline value affects new target, its achievement and presentation of progress over time
新基准对目标与进展的影响
Description of how new baseline value affects new target, its achievement and presentation of progress over time。新基准对目标与进展的影响。以目标对象、目标年、基准年、排放范围和范围2方法区分事实；绝对减排、相对减排和强度目标不可互换。碳信用和移除不能直接替代毛排放减量。
